metadata.title: Error codes — Nebula
metadata.description: Look up the code in the v2 error window to see what happened and what to try.

page.paragraph_2: Look up the code in the v2 error window to see what happened and what to try.
page.paragraph_3: These instructions cover the upcoming update. The current public download is v1.0.2.

codes.paragraph_1: No matching codes. Try another word or use the bug report guide.
codes.paragraph_2: The game's code crashed, with no mod changing the game.
codes.paragraph_3: Start again; if it repeats at the same place, report it with the report file.
codes.paragraph_4: The game stopped itself with an error (its own fatal check); the report quotes its message.
codes.paragraph_5: Start again. If the same problem repeats, report it with the report file.
codes.paragraph_6: The game's code ran out of stack space.
codes.paragraph_7: Start again. If the same problem repeats, report it with the report file.
codes.paragraph_8: The game crashed while mods changed its files or code; the report lists them.
codes.paragraph_9: Turn the mods off and play again; if it no longer happens, turn them on one at a time.
codes.paragraph_10: The game crashed within 15 seconds of reading a file a mod supplies; the report names the mod and the file.
codes.paragraph_11: Turn that mod off, or check it is made for this game's region and version.
codes.paragraph_12: A texture pack image stopped Nebula while it loaded; the report names the file.
codes.paragraph_13: Remove the image from the pack or save it again as a PNG.
codes.paragraph_14: A replacement movie stopped Nebula while it played; the report names the file.
codes.paragraph_15: Remove the video or convert it to an H.264 MP4.
codes.paragraph_16: The graphics driver reset the graphics card (device removed, hung or lost).
codes.paragraph_17: Update the driver; turn off ray tracing and frame generation or lower the internal resolution.
codes.paragraph_18: The renderer stopped on another error; the report quotes it.
codes.paragraph_19: Update the driver; report it if it repeats.
codes.paragraph_21: Close other programs, set texture packs to On instead of Preload, or lower the internal resolution.
codes.paragraph_22: Nebula's own code crashed (not the game's).
codes.paragraph_23: Start again; report it if it repeats.
codes.paragraph_24: Nebula stopped on an unexpected error; the report quotes it.
codes.paragraph_25: Start again. If it repeats, report it with the report file.
codes.paragraph_27: Start again. If it repeats, report it with the report file.
codes.paragraph_28: Nebula stopped on an internal error while starting.
codes.paragraph_29: Start again. If it repeats, report it with the report file.
codes.paragraph_30: The game content (`game.pak`) was not found or could not be opened.
codes.paragraph_31: Run Nebula Setup again, or choose the content in Nebula settings > Advanced.
codes.paragraph_33: Run Nebula Setup again to rebuild it from your disc image.
codes.paragraph_34: Nebula's files do not match each other.
codes.paragraph_36: The graphics card could not start the game.
codes.paragraph_37: Update the driver; with two graphics cards, choose the other in Nebula settings > Display.
codes.paragraph_38: Nebula's settings file could not be read.
codes.paragraph_39: Rename `config.ini` in Nebula's settings folder to start with default settings.
codes.paragraph_40: Nebula was started with options it does not know.
codes.paragraph_41: Start Nebula from its launcher or shortcut.

report.paragraph_1: Attach the newest report from your Nebula crashes folder and describe the steps that caused the problem. Review the report before sharing it.
